data.title: SET hosts “The 4th SET Annual Conference on Family Business”
data.description: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) invites business owners, next-generation successors, executives and family business advisers to “The 4th SET Annual Conference on Family Business”, held under the theme “Growth & Resilience in an Uncertain World” on Friday, Sept 25, 2026. The event will take place from 8.30am to 3.30pm at the Professor Sangvian Indaravijaya Auditorium, 7th floor, SET Building, Bangkok.

data.title: Retail and mixed-use boom pushes Siam land values to THB4m per square wah
data.description: Retail and mixed-use projects are reshaping Bangkok’s Siam Square and Pathum Wan, where land values have climbed to THB3.8–4 million per square wah.

data.title: Firefighters push to ‘encircle’ Belgian wildfire
data.description: SOURBRODT, Belgium - Firefighters launched a potentially decisive push Tuesday to encircle Belgium’s largest wildfire in a century, despite wind and rain hampering air support operations over the High Fens nature reserve.

data.title: Russia rebukes Japanese envoy in disputed islands row
data.description: MOSCOW - Russia on Tuesday rebuked Japan’s ambassador to Moscow over the disputed Kuril islands, which President Vladimir Putin visited for the first time last week.

data.title: Pakistani court orders ex-PM Khan moved from jail to hospital
data.description: ISLAMABAD - Pakistan’s Supreme Court ordered on Tuesday that jailed former prime minister Imran Khan be moved to hospital for medical checks, after a petition by his lawyers over claims of poor health.

data.title: ILO, Thai Union Strengthen Seafood Sector’s Support for Migrant Workers
data.description: BANGKOK, AUGUST 18, 2026— The International Labor Organization (ILO) and Thai Union Group have launched a pilot trainingprogrammeto strengthen front-line leadership skills across Thailand’s seafood processing sector. The initiative aims to improve workplace communication, strengthenlabourpractices, and support decent work, particularly in workplaces employing large numbers of migrant workers.

data.title: Alcoholism and Alcohol Use Disorder: A 2026 Research and News Summary
data.description: Throughout 2026, several major developments have reshaped both scientific understanding of alcohol's health effects and the landscape of available treatments.

data.title: Singha Lemon Soda Surges in South Korea Launches New Sugar-Free “Lime Lemon”
data.description: Singha Lemon Soda continues to scale its presence in South Korea, introducing its newest flavour, "Lime Lemon." It was developed exclusively for Korean tastes, highlighting real lemon freshness with zero sugar and zero calories.

data.title: Spacewalk a first for French female astronaut
data.description: WASHINGTON - Sophie Adenot is set to become the first French female astronaut to venture outside the International Space Station for a spacewalk on Tuesday, accompanied by American astronaut Anil Menon.

data.title: Immobilised Japan fighter jet leads to runway closure at Okinawa airport
data.description: A runway was closed at Naha Airport in the southern island prefecture of Okinawa on Tuesday after a Japanese Self-Defense Forces fighter jet became immobilized following landing, according to the transport ministry.

data.title: 'It's my job,' says officer who ticketed upset Malaysian biker
data.description: SONGKHLA - A Thai police officer targeted by a Malaysian biker who called on followers to boycott Thailand after he and his friends were pulled over and ticketed for a range of offences in Hat Yai has defended his actions, insisting he was only doing his legal duty.

data.title: Bogus ‘pink card’ racket broken up in Bangkok
data.description: Thai authorities have arrested seven people, including three civil servants, after uncovering the fraudulent registration of hundreds of foreign children at the Din Daeng Flats in Bangkok.

data.title: More Trump-Kim 'love'? What we know about North Korea
data.description: SEOUL - United States President Donald Trump says Kim Jong Un had responded to his recent overtures and praised his relationship with the North Korean leader a day after scaling back military drills with South Korea.

data.title: Major Meta trial begins as lawyers spar over witnesses, damages
data.description: OAKLAND — Facebook-parent Meta will defend itself in a landmark social media trial that begins Tuesday in California, where attorneys have sparred over witnesses and financial penalties.

data.title: Eau de nostalgia: Gap relaunches ‘Grass’
data.description: Gap Beauty has revived its iconic collection of eaux de parfum, bringing back a selection of scents that have long held a place in the memories of fragrance lovers.

data.title: Photos with peace signs may reveal fingerprint data, ministry warns
data.description: A simple peace sign in a social media photo could expose sensitive biometric data to cybercriminals, Thailand’s Interior Ministry has warned, as advances in artificial intelligence (AI) and smartphone camera technology make it easier to extract fingerprint details from high-resolution images.

data.title: ONE Championship: Rodtang handed comeback fight offer as Chatri promises news ‘soon’
data.description: Rodtang Jitmuangnon has been offered his first ONE Championship fight since signing a lucrative new contract with the promotion, with chairman and CEO Chatri Sityodtong promising an announcement “soon”.

data.title: Thailand targets 14-15 golds at Asian Games
data.description: <p>The National Olympic Committee of Thailand (NOCT) has set a target of 14-15 gold medals at the Asian Games, which will take place in Aichi-Nagoya from Sept 19 to Oct 4.</p>

data.title: “Under One Moon”
data.description: GaysornVillage presents an exclusive Mid-Autumn collaboration between Chef Janice Wong and 1823 Tea Lounge by Ronnefeldt, bringing together contemporary pastry artistry and over 200 years of tea heritage

data.title: Andaman tsunami buoy to be replaced in November
data.description: <p>A tsunami-monitoring buoy off the Andaman coast will be replaced in November after it stopped transmitting data, with officials blaming possible damage from strong southwest monsoon waves.</p>

data.title: Spot checks reveal misuse of school lunch programme funds
data.description: SURAT THANI - Surprise inspections by anti-corruption officials at six schools have uncovered irregularities in the schools' student-lunch programmes, including mismanagement of funds and poor nutrition.

data.title: Make it rain: Indonesia chases clouds to stem El Nino fires
data.description: PALANGKARAYA — Indonesia's Borneo, home to pristine rainforest and protected species, is burning. Meteorologist Safillah Anggie Wahyuni hopes a solution lies in the clouds.

data.title: Transylvania's fortified churches face fragile future
data.description: MOşNA (ROMANIA) - Built in the Middle Ages to provide shelter from attacks, Transylvania's fortified churches risk crumbling despite efforts to preserve and breathe new life into them.

data.title: Japan stresses 'critical cooperation' as Trump slashes S.Korea drills
data.description: SEOUL - Japan underlined on Tuesday that security cooperation with the United States and South Korea was "critical" for the region's stability, after President Donald Trump alarmed allies by scaling back military drills with Seoul while hailing his ties with Pyongyang.
